headline: Sign applications on Loudon Road, Commercial Street, Wall Street, and Capitol Street, plus a Pleasant Street restaurant loggia and a 21-unit residential conversion at 103 North State Street.
summary: Reviews include sign applications at several sites and building permit applications for Pleasant Street, South Main Street, and 103 North State Street. A site plan application for converting an office building into apartments is also on the agenda.
items: Sign application at 80 Commercial St: new 37.2-square-foot internally illuminated building wall sign (SP-0746-2026)
Sign application at 16 Wall Street: new 8.81-square-foot externally illuminated freestanding sign to replace an existing sign (SP-0755-2026)
Sign application at 8 Loudon Rd: new 35-square-foot internally illuminated building wall sign (SP-0759-2026)
Sign applications at 1 Capitol St: two new non-illuminated building wall signs of 18.5 square feet (SP-0760-2026) and 23.75 square feet (SP-0761-2026) to replace two existing signs
Sign application at 388 Loudon Rd: new 42-square-foot internally illuminated freestanding sign panel to replace an existing panel (SP-0762-2026)

Sign applications at 285 Loudon Rd: two new 33.28-square-foot internally illuminated building wall signs (SP-0751-2026 and SP-0752-2026) and a new 30.5-square-foot internally illuminated freestanding sign panel (SP-0753-2026)

Building permit application at 60 Pleasant Street, 62 Pleasant Street, and 2-10 N Spring St: 650-square-foot façade alteration to build a loggia in front of an existing restaurant, and relocation of a 12-square-foot freestanding pylon sign
Building permit application at 38 South Main Street: replacement of an existing storefront, sidelights, and transom, and installation of a fence along the north side of the building
Site plan application at 103 North State Street: conversion of an existing 15,341-square-foot office building into 21 residential dwelling units and related site improvements
location: City Council Chambers, 37 Green St, Concord, NH 03301

ARCHITECTURAL DESIGN REVIEW COMMITTEE 
May 5, 2026, 8:30 a.m. 
City Council Chambers, 37 Green St, Concord, NH 03301 
 
AGENDA 
 
1. Call to Order 
2. Minutes – Approve meeting minutes from March 31, 2026 
3. Staff Memorandum 
4. Sign Applications 
4.1 Advantage Signs, on behalf of New Hampshire Retirement System, requests an architectural design review 
recommendation for a new 37.2-square-foot internally illuminated building wall sign (SP-0746-2026) at 80 
Commercial St in the Opportunity Corridor Performance (OCP) District. (2026 -030) (PL-ADR-2026-0171). 
(2026-031) (PL-CUP-2026-0109) 
4.2 Wall Street Dental Group, PLLC, on behalf of 16 Wall St LLC, and Wall Street Dental Group, requests an 
architectural design review recommendation for a new 8.81-square-foot externally illuminated freestanding

District. (2026-032) (PL-ADR-2026-0172) 
4.3 Green Bear Signs and Graphic, LLC, on behalf of Flomac Limited Partnership, and Back Nine, requests an 
architectural design review recommendation for a new 35-square-foot internally illuminated building wall sign 
(SP-0759-2026) at 8 Loudon Rd in the Gateway Performance (GWP) District. (2026-036) (PL-ADR-2026-
0174) 
4.4 Merrimack County Savings Bank/NH Mutual Bancorp, on behalf of Capitol Street Associates and Ransmeier

existing building wall signs at 1 Capitol St in the Central Business Performance (CBP) District. (2026-037) 
(PL-ADR-2026-0175)

Performance (GWP) District. (2026-039) (PL-ADR-2026-0177) 
4.6 Classic Signs Inc. LLC, on behalf of GMX-RP-SCU-Concord LLC, Dundee Investments LLC, and Service 
Credit Union requests architectural design review recommendations for two new 33.28- square-foot internally 
illuminated building wall signs (SP-0751-2026 and SP-0752-2026) and a new 30.5-square-foot internally 
illuminated freestanding sign panel (SP-0753-2026) to be placed on an existing freestanding sign, at 285 
Loudon Rd in the Gateway Performance (GWP) District. (2026-043) (PL-ADR-2026-0178)
